sourceScope: Frozen current working simulation including uncommitted frontier, building, terrain, performance and almanac foundations. These are not runs of featureCommit alone.

calibration.method: Monthly real footprint-connectivity and centre partitioning with prescribed population and wealth paths. No full economic dynamics in controlled pairs. This is behavioral calibration, not a historical estimate.

limits: Two frontier seeds and one settled seed are a small synthetic sample, not historical validation.
No full natural-world mergers occurred; merger thresholds are calibrated against explicit controlled scenarios.
Frontier population fell by 81–88%; food and demographic calibration remain unresolved. Passing conservation is not economic plausibility.
The established world retains coarse housing rather than reconstructed building lots.
Annual relationship diagnostics report the leader and ratios, not the subordinate identity; exact identities remain in the event history.
The shared working tree contains other work that was deliberately not committed as part of this task.

settledCheckpointEquivalence.reason: Incorporation thresholds are identical and the tuned waiting period is longer, so no earlier incorporation is possible. Merger requires incorporation. With no currently eligible overwhelming relation, both policies have the same state at this checkpoint.
